other_failure_modes.name: Inconsistent categorical encoding across splits
other_failure_modes.description: The agent applies categorical encoding (e.g., using .cat.codes or a new LabelEncoder) independently on the train and test sets. If the sets have different unique categories or missing values, the same category will receive different integer codes in train and test, destroying the feature's meaning.

summary: The agent provides a robust cross-validated solution with good feature engineering. However, it introduces a critical flaw by independently encoding categorical variables in train and test using `.cat.codes`, which will scramble the category mappings if unique values differ. It also leaks the test distribution by frequency-encoding on the combined datasets and relies on naive ensembling.
